Wednesday

READY TO UNLOCK THE 

SCENT OF HOGWARTS™?

 

Meet our official Harry Potter wax melt collection, created for fans who notice every tiny detail. Each wax melt  is a little work of art, with sculpted designs inspired by the wizarding world, from house crests to iconic 

symbols hidden in every cube. 

We spent months perfecting the moulds so that every time you snap a cube, it feels like opening a small piece of magic. These melts are made in small batches, not on a factory line.

 

Whether you are Gryffindor, Slytherin, Ravenclaw or Hufflepuff, this is the perfect cosy treat for any Harry Potter fan, and an unforgettable gift for someone you love.
